target_categories.name: Operations & Traffic
target_categories.description: Train delays, schedule disruptions, punctuality problems, unscheduled crossings, and train cancellations.

target_categories.name: Passenger Grievance
target_categories.description: Staff misbehaviour, corruption or bribery demands by ticket examiners, unauthorized overcrowding in reserved coaches, ticketing booking failures, and refund disputes.

target_categories.name: Housekeeping
target_categories.description: Coach cleanliness, dirty toilets, foul smell, pest/cockroach infestations, garbage disposal, and soiled/torn bedrolls and linen.

target_categories.name: Security
target_categories.description: Theft of luggage and valuables, harassment, safety threats, unauthorized persons entering compartments, and calls for RPF intervention.

target_categories.name: Electrical
target_categories.description: Air conditioning non-cooling or failure, non-functional fans, lights off/fused, and defective mobile charging sockets.

target_categories.name: Catering
target_categories.description: Food quality, unhygienic pantry cars, overcharging for meals, missing meals, stale snacks, and poor beverage services.

target_categories.name: Coach Maintenance
target_categories.description: Physical coach damage, broken window panes, leaking coach roofs, damaged berths, loose latches, and structural rattles.

target_categories.name: Water & Sanitation
target_categories.description: Unavailability of water in coach washrooms, empty train water tanks, dry washbasins, and platform water tap failures.

medical assistance.reason: Excluded due to severe sample scarcity (only 11 genuine complaints in dataset; 0.6% representation) to maintain statistical evaluation rigor across fully-supported categories.

engineering.reason: Excluded because 0 civil engineering complaint records exist in the source dataset.

service.reason: Vague, highly diffuse complaints spanning policy, platform signs, or general customer support without specific domain clarity.

miscellaneous.reason: Catch-all label containing noisy, multi-topic, or idiosyncratic grievances that lack coherent semantic boundaries.

facility.reason: Generic observations about station waiting rooms or multi-service deficiencies without distinct operational target.

others.reason: Unspecified feedback, meme references, and social commentary.

political.reason: Political arguments, ministry criticism, senior citizen concession policy debates, and government privatization debates.

loss/found.reason: Inquiries regarding misplaced personal items rather than service complaints.

facilities.reason: Vague infrastructure remarks lacking department-specific resolution.

request/suggestion.reason: User suggestions rather than actionable complaints.
